visual.name: advanVisSmartLine
visual.description: Line and area charts that label the points that matter and explain the trend in plain English. Free: line, smooth, stepped and area styles, up to six series or a Legend, smart labels on the first, last, highest and lowest points, end-of-line series names, peak and trough markers, trend and moving-average lines, average, median and fixed reference lines, reference bands, a shaded period, a zoom slider, drill-down, vector export and a basic headline. Pro (one-month free trial): the full smart headline and findings with How calculated, smart design tips, last year as a dashed line, a target line with the gap shaded, and an IBCS-style variance strip under the chart.

dataRoles.description: The periods along the bottom: dates, months, quarters or years. Add more fields to drill down.
dataRoles.name: category

dataRoles.description: Optional. Splits the measure into one line per value: a line per region, product or channel.
dataRoles.name: series

dataRoles.description: The numeric field each line follows. Without a Legend, up to six measures become six lines.
dataRoles.name: measure

dataRoles.description: Optional. Measures drawn against their own scale on the right: a margin % beside revenue, units beside value. Not used with a Legend.
dataRoles.name: secondary

dataRoles.description: Optional, Pro. Last year or last month: a dashed line, the change on the last label, and what changed.
dataRoles.name: comparison

dataRoles.description: Optional, Pro. A goal, budget or plan per period: a target line with the gap shaded, scored met or missed.
dataRoles.name: target

dataRoles.description: Optional. A text field with a note for some periods (a launch, an outage, a price change): numbered on the line and listed under the chart. Use First, not Count.
dataRoles.name: comments

dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra measures to show when hovering a period.
dataRoles.name: tooltips

dataRoles.description: Optional. A 0/1 measure: the chart is drawn only when it is 1. When it is 0 or blank, a message is shown instead and no values are revealed.
dataRoles.name: showCondition

enumeration.displayName: Auto (when the points are far apart)
Auto (left when wide, top when tall)
